svg.title: September IR snapshot: writer ownership, expression handling and historical comparisons
svg.desc: Historical code snapshot, 22 September 2026. IR-fed writer ownership on the reference Java route is 93,703 of 174,141 reference files (53.8 percent) across 25 pinned Rune 9.83 model-release cells and 11 file kinds, excluding chaos: enums, data types and choices with their derived files. These writers still use legacy helpers and templates; this is not independent-emission credit or certification. Function and rule handling measure expression claims, separately from whole files. The upstream comparison tile reports the separately dated 2 September evidence: 174,129 identical files and 12 named non-emissions out of 174,141 references on each compatibility route across those 25 cells and 11 kinds, with line endings normalised. Optimised converted-site and Python root counts were measured on 17 September; the paired-execution census of 150,831 over 21 cells was run on 22 September. Optimised emission remains AST-hosted; Python is exploratory. The intended completion plan is separate in ROADMAP.md.
